title: Lily’s Magical Plant Quest
moral: Being brave and kind helps you overcome challenges.

scenes.summary: Lily sets out to find a magical plant.
scenes.text: Lily went into the forest to find a glowing magical plant.

story: Lily went into the forest to find a magical glowing plant. She crossed a stream, avoided prickly plants, and climbed logs. She stayed brave and solved problems along the way. Finally, she found the glowing plant and carefully brought it home. With her mom, she kept it safe and felt proud of her adventure.
